Module dev.metaschema.core
Package dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter

Class HexBinaryAdapter

java.lang.Object
dev.metaschema.core.datatype.AbstractDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer,ITEM_TYPE>
dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.AbstractBinaryAdapter<IHexBinaryItem>
dev.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.HexBinaryAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
IDataTypeAdapter<ByteBuffer>
public class HexBinaryAdapter extends AbstractBinaryAdapter<IHexBinaryItem>
Maintains a byte buffer backed representation of a byte stream parsed from a base64 encoded string.

Provides support for the Metaschema base64 data type.
